ownership: Public exempt-organization records disclosed by the IRS in the EO Business Master File Extract
source_access: Public anonymous read-only HTTPS page and monthly regional CSV downloads.
allowed_use: redistribution of approved public normalized fields with IRS attribution and semantic limitations
prohibited_use: representing EO BMF coverage as every nonprofit, exempt organization, employer, operating establishment, or U.S. business
representing a filing or headquarters address as a verified physical operating site or public storefront
representing current-extract membership as independent proof of ongoing operations
inferring parent, subordinate, chapter, ownership, or control relationships from group or affiliation codes alone
exporting the ICO in-care-of personal-contact field in normalized or registry records
merging organizations across sources without versioned evidence
attribution: Source: U.S. Internal Revenue Service Exempt Organizations Business Master File Extract.
retention: Indefinite for immutable source and approved normalized records unless an approved retention rule applies.
redistribution: Approved public normalized fields may be redistributed with IRS attribution, source posting date, source checksums, provenance, filing-address semantics, and coverage limitations retained; raw CSVs remain internal.
personal_data_handling: The public ICO in-care-of field can identify an officer, director, or other contact. It is retained only in internal raw source CSVs and never emitted to normalized or registry artifacts.
